editorial.title_zh: 欧盟对印度、日本、台湾、土耳其及越南冷轧钢材征收最终反倾销税，11月17日生效
editorial.title_en: EU definitive anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam take effect on 17 November
editorial.summary_zh: 【正式法规】欧盟执行条例(EU)2026/2547于11月13日通过、11月16日刊登，按第3条于11月17日生效。第1条规定：印度9.5%；日本27.9%；台湾合作企业20.7%、其他27%；土耳其Tatmetal 3%、Borçelik及其他企业7.8%、附件列明的其他合作企业4.9%；越南16%。税基为未完税欧盟边境净价。范围为特定未镀覆冷轧铁、非合金钢及其他合金钢扁平材，涉及部分7209、7211、7225、7226税号；不含不锈钢，另排除规定的电工钢、硅电钢、高速钢，以及厚度小于0.35毫米的退火卷状黑铁皮。企业单独税率须凭符合第1(3)条的商业发票声明，具体产品及TARIC附加码以条文和附件为准。
editorial.summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/2547 was adopted on 13 November, published on 16 November and enters into force on 17 November 2026 under Article 3. Article 1 sets duties of 9.5% for India, 27.9% for Japan, 20.7% for cooperating Taiwanese producers and 27% otherwise; Türkiye: Tatmetal 3%, Borçelik and residual imports 7.8%, other listed cooperators 4.9%; Vietnam 16%. Duties apply to the net Union-frontier price before duty. Specified uncoated cold-rolled iron/non-alloy/other-alloy flat products are covered under parts of CN 7209, 7211, 7225 and 7226. Stainless steel, specified electrical/silicon-electrical and high-speed steels, and annealed black-plate coils below 0.35 mm are excluded. Individual rates require the prescribed invoice declaration; consult Article 1 and the Annex for exact scope and additional TARIC codes.
editorial.impact_zh: 【业务研判】即使本案没有把中国大陆列为涉案原产地，也会改变欧盟进口冷轧的到岸成本比较。可向欧洲汽车、家电、服务中心客户核对上述来源在途与新采购，按具体钢厂税率、产品范围和交货时间重算报价；土耳其不同企业不能统一按最高税率估算。部分受影响供货可能转向中东、北非等市场，形成新的报价压力，这属于需跟踪的贸易转移情景。中国钢材是否具备替代机会仍需另核对其自身适用措施、配额、CBAM和客户认证，不能由本案推定自动受益。
editorial.impact_en: Business assessment: the measure changes EU landed-cost comparisons even though mainland China is not a named origin. Check customers’ shipments and sourcing plans against producer-specific duties, scope and delivery timing, particularly the differing Turkish rates. Diversion into the Middle East or North Africa could intensify price competition; this is a scenario to monitor, not an established outcome. Any substitution opportunity for Chinese steel still depends on its own applicable measures, quotas, CBAM and customer qualification.
editorial.coverage: 2026-11-16读取DG TRADE官方通告和EUR-Lex正式条例163页PDF；核对第160至162页Article 1–3及第163页附件，并目视核对税率表。已核对产品排除项、企业税率、发票条件和生效日；未逐项复核调查计算及各具体报关产品归类。

follow_up.action_zh: 核对欧盟客户上述五个来源的在途与拟采购冷轧，按制造商、CN/TARIC及商业发票重算成本；跟踪中东和北非转向报价。
follow_up.action_en: Check EU customers’ incoming and planned cold-rolled purchases from the five origins by producer, CN/TARIC and invoice; track diverted offers into the Middle East and North Africa.
